name: create_video_from_avatar
description:
Create a video from a HeyGen avatar (video or photo avatar).

Provide an avatar_id to use a previously created avatar. Supports all
avatar types: studio_avatar, digital_twin, and photo_avatar. Optionally
set ``engine`` to select Avatar V for eligible avatars; when omitted, the
server defaults to Avatar IV.

avatarId.description: HeyGen avatar ID (video avatar or photo avatar look ID).
avatarId.title: Avatarid

title.description: Display title for the video in the HeyGen dashboard.
title.title: Title

aspectRatio.description: Output video aspect ratio. Supported values: '16:9', '9:16', '4:5', '5:4', '1:1', 'auto'. Defaults to '16:9'. 'auto' preserves the source's aspect ratio (avatar source frames or uploaded image), short-edge anchored to the requested resolution and capped at the tier's long edge. Falls back to '16:9' when source dimensions can't be read.
aspectRatio.title: Aspectratio

fit.description: How the subject is fitted to the output canvas. 'cover' scales to fill the frame (may crop edges). 'contain' scales to fit entirely within the frame (may show background). When omitted, the server picks the best option based on the source and canvas orientations.
fit.title: Fit

removeBackground.description: Remove the avatar background. Video avatars must be trained with matting enabled.
removeBackground.title: Removebackground

callbackUrl.description: Webhook URL to receive a POST notification when the video is ready.
callbackUrl.title: Callbackurl

callbackId.description: Caller-defined identifier echoed back in the webhook payload.
callbackId.title: Callbackid

caption.description: Caption generation settings. A sidecar subtitle file is always returned via subtitle_url; set 'style' to additionally burn captions into the rendered video.

outputFormat.description: Output container. 'webm' returns a video with a transparent background (alpha channel); 'mp4' (default) returns a standard video. 'webm' requires an avatar that supports matting. When 'webm' is selected, any 'background' value is rejected and background removal is applied automatically — the caller does not need to set 'remove_background'.
outputFormat.title: Outputformat

script.description: Text script for the avatar to speak. Pair with voice_id, or omit voice_id when using avatar_id to use the avatar's default voice. Mutually exclusive with audio_url/audio_asset_id.
script.title: Script

voiceId.description: Voice ID for text-to-speech. Required when script is provided, unless avatar_id is set (the avatar's default voice is used as fallback).
voiceId.title: Voiceid

audioUrl.description: Public URL of an audio file to lip-sync. Mutually exclusive with script.
audioUrl.title: Audiourl

audioAssetId.description: HeyGen asset ID of an uploaded audio file. Mutually exclusive with script.
audioAssetId.title: Audioassetid

motionPrompt.description: Natural-language prompt controlling avatar body motion and hand gestures. Supported for photo avatars on either engine, and for video avatars when engine.type is 'avatar_v'. Rejected for video avatars on the default Avatar IV engine.
motionPrompt.title: Motionprompt

expressiveness.description: Avatar expressiveness level. Photo avatars only. Defaults to 'low' when omitted. Avatar IV only; rejected when engine.type is 'avatar_v'.
expressiveness.title: Expressiveness

engine.description: Engine configuration for video generation. Pass {"type": "avatar_v"} to enable cross-reference-driven animation for higher quality. Check supported_api_engines on the avatar look to confirm eligibility. Defaults to Avatar IV when omitted.
engine.title: Engine

AvatarIIIEngineConfig.description:
Avatar III engine configuration.

A single engine value that resolves to the right product by the avatar's
look type (mirrors how ``avatar_iv`` already serves both photo and video
avatars):

- ``digital_twin`` look  -> Digital Twin (supports 4K)
- ``photo_avatar`` look  -> Photo Avatar (no 4K output)

Not supported for ``studio_avatar`` looks or raw image input.
``motion_prompt`` and ``expressiveness`` are not supported with this engine.
Check ``supported_api_engines`` on the avatar look to confirm eligibility.

type.description: Engine type discriminator. Must be 'avatar_iii'. Resolves to Digital Twin for digital_twin looks and Photo Avatar for photo_avatar looks; rejected for studio_avatar looks. Check supported_api_engines on the avatar look to confirm eligibility.
type.title: Type

AvatarIIIEngineConfig.title: AvatarIIIEngineConfig

AvatarVEngineConfig.description: Avatar V engine configuration with cross-reference-driven animation.

type.description: Engine type discriminator. Must be 'avatar_v'. Check supported_api_engines on the avatar look to confirm eligibility.
type.title: Type

reference_look_id.description: Optional instant_avatar look to use as the animation reference. Must be an `instant_avatar` look (studio / photo / other look types are rejected) belonging to the same avatar group as `avatar_id`. When omitted, video avatars self-reference and photo avatars auto-select the best instant_avatar sibling in their group.
reference_look_id.title: Reference Look Id

AvatarVEngineConfig.title: AvatarVEngineConfig

BackgroundSetting.description: Background configuration for the generated video.

type.description: Background type. 'color' uses a solid hex color; 'image' uses an image from url or asset_id.
type.title: Type

value.description: Hex color code (e.g. '#ff0000'). Required when type is 'color'.
value.title: Value

url.description: URL of the background image. Used when type is 'image'. Mutually exclusive with asset_id.
url.title: Url

asset_id.description: HeyGen asset ID of the background image. Used when type is 'image'. Mutually exclusive with url.
asset_id.title: Asset Id

BackgroundSetting.title: BackgroundSetting

CaptionSetting.description:
Caption generation settings for video creation.

A sidecar subtitle file is always generated and returned via ``subtitle_url``
in the chosen ``file_format``. When ``style`` is also set, captions are
additionally burned into the rendered video — the sidecar is still delivered.

file_format.description: Output format for the sidecar caption file.

style.description: Visual style for burning captions into the rendered video. Omit for sidecar-only captions.

CaptionSetting.title: CaptionSetting

CaptionStyle.description: Visual style applied when burning captions into the rendered video.
CaptionStyle.title: CaptionStyle

ElevenLabsEngineSettings.description:
Engine-specific voice settings for ElevenLabs-backed voices.

Inherits the ElevenLabs tuning fields (model, stability, similarity_boost, style,
use_speaker_boost) along with the eleven_v3 stability validator from
:class:`movio.api_service.app.api_types.video.ElevenLabsSettings`.

model.description: The model ID to use for ElevenLabs.

similarity_boost.description: The similarity boost parameter for ElevenLabs.
similarity_boost.title: Similarity Boost

use_speaker_boost.description: Whether to use speaker boost for ElevenLabs.
use_speaker_boost.title: Use Speaker Boost

engine_type.description: Engine type discriminator. Must be 'elevenlabs' for ElevenLabs-backed voices.
engine_type.title: Engine Type

ElevenLabsEngineSettings.title: ElevenLabsEngineSettings

ElevenLabsModel.description:
ElevenLabs model IDs exposed on the public API.

Only current models are included — deprecated models (monolingual_v1, multilingual_v1,
turbo_v2) are not accepted. The web auto-remaps them to newer equivalents; the API
should not offer models we wouldn't recommend using.
ElevenLabsModel.title: ElevenLabsModel

FishEngineSettings.description:
Engine-specific voice settings for Fish Audio-backed voices.

Inherits Fish's tuning fields (model, stability, similarity).

stability.description: Stability parameter; higher is more consistent.
stability.title: Stability

similarity.description: Similarity parameter; how closely to match the source voice.
similarity.title: Similarity

engine_type.description: Engine type discriminator. Must be 'fish' for Fish Audio-backed voices.
engine_type.title: Engine Type

FishEngineSettings.title: FishEngineSettings

FishModel.description: Fish Audio model version. Mirrors the choices exposed on the web (FISH_MODELS).
FishModel.title: FishModel

StarfishEngineSettings.description:
Engine-selection for Starfish-backed voices.

Starfish has no user-tunable settings today; set ``engine_type='starfish'`` to force
Starfish routing on voices that support multiple engines.

engine_type.description: Engine type discriminator. Must be 'starfish' for Starfish-backed voices.
engine_type.title: Engine Type

StarfishEngineSettings.title: StarfishEngineSettings

VoiceSettingsInput.description:
Voice tuning parameters for text-to-speech.

Applies only when 'script' + 'voice_id' are provided — not when audio_url/audio_asset_id
is used (uploaded audio bypasses TTS).

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier. 0.5 (half speed) to 1.5 (1.5x speed).
speed.title: Speed

volume.description: Voice audio volume. 1.0 = full, 0.0 = silent. Useful when mixing spoken voice with background audio.
volume.title: Volume

engine_settings.description: Engine-specific voice tuning, discriminated by 'engine_type'. Use the variant matching the engine backing the chosen voice (e.g. engine_type='elevenlabs' for ElevenLabs-backed voices). The request is rejected if the voice_id is not compatible with the selected engine.
engine_settings.title: Engine Settings

VoiceSettingsInput.title: VoiceSettingsInput
